title: Moderate shower
description: Typical monsoon afternoon shower (45 mm total) — routine load on drains.
source: Assumed. IMD 'moderate' is 15.6–64.4 mm/day; packed into 3 h here.

title: Design storm (network sizing basis)
description: The storm the simulated drains are sized for (D-20, 40 mm in 2 h) — default for development checks.
source: Assumed design intensity 20 mm/h (P06, D-20); Salt Lake design standard unknown.

title: Heavy downpour
description: Intense convective cell (80 mm in 2 h) — exceeds IMD 'heavy' (≥ 64.5 mm/day) in two hours.
source: Assumed design storm; IMD heavy-rain threshold 64.5 mm/day (imd_thresholds).

title: Extreme cloudburst-type event
description: Very heavy burst (160 mm in 2 h) — stress test near the IMD 'very heavy' class in a single event.
source: Assumed stress test; IMD very heavy 115.6–204.4 mm/day (imd_thresholds).

title: ERA5 record day, compressed
description: The wettest day in the 1981–present ERA5 record for this grid cell, delivered over 6 h. (34.2 mm on 2004-08-09)
source: om_archive (ERA5 reanalysis, modelled). Reanalysis under-represents local extremes.
